title: repositories
description: A repository of the dataset with its corpus and GitHub metadata. The commit filter reads is_fork, description and topics; table 1 and figures 3-4 read the rest. Key: repo.

repo.description: Repository as owner/name, as requested at collection time.

corpus.description: Corpus of the repository. A: every commit, issue and pull request. B: commits whose message names a PQC term or that belong to a pull request whose title or body names one, and issues and pull requests whose title or body names one. C: repositories with no issues or pull requests; every commit.

url.description: Link to the repository on GitHub.

is_fork.description: True if the repository is a fork on GitHub.

created_at.description: When the repository was created on GitHub.

github_pull_requests.description: GitHub's count of the repository's pull requests (any state) when its corpus was assigned.

github_issues.description: GitHub's count of the repository's issues (any state) when its corpus was assigned.

git_commits.description: Commits in the full Git history (every fetched ref) before selection.

fetched_at.description: When the repository metadata was fetched.
